QUÉDATE TONIGHT – JACK HIT & OLIVIA HIT | OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO
One night. Two hearts. A love you never want to end.
"Quédate Tonight" — Stay Tonight.
Experience "Quédate Tonight" by Jack Hit & Olivia Hit, a romantic musical journey where English meets Spanish and emotions speak louder than words.
Some nights are unforgettable.
Some feelings are impossible to hide.
And sometimes, all you want is for that special someone to stay a little longer.
Quédate conmigo esta noche.
